instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the exact visual identity from the CRM - Concept Gas Craft PDF: Dark navy sidebar (#0F1A2C), clean white cards (#FFFFFF) on slate page (#F8FAFC), with safety orange accent (#EA580C) and crisp status badges.

Implement all key CRM modules: Dashboard, Leads, Quotes with live document preview & GST 15%, Sales Orders, Jobs & Schedule with technician columns, Timesheets with Clock-in/out, Billing/Invoices, Assets with WOF/Rego/Calibration tracker, Customers, Reports with Recharts, Gas Safety Certificates, and Technician Mobile View.
Include a public customer quote acceptance route (/public/quote/:id) where a client can review line items, click 'Accept Quote', sign digitally, and automatically trigger Job creation.

Pre-seed comprehensive realistic NZ trade data: residential & commercial gas boiler installs, heat pumps, cylinder replacements, gas certifications with NZ practitioner licenses, Auckland/Wellington service addresses, and vehicle/tool calibration expiry alerts.
Ensure every interactive button, input, tab, and row has a descriptive data-testid for end-to-end reliability.
Keep styling modular, using Tailwind v4 utility classes and Lucide icons without generic AI slop.
